title: SIDESTORY: A WALK IN THE DUST RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: A WALK IN THE DUST RERUN
EVENT DURATION: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: A Walk in The Dust event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Walk Alone] Duration: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[The Endless Road] Duration: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[SONG OF DUST]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Song of Dust] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Heavyrain, Critical Response Team Office (Pieces), Scattered Sketches.
[REEFSTEEP BLACK MARKET]
DURATION: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Scattered Sketches by clearing event stages and Song of Dust missions. Scattered Sketches can be used to redeem items.
MAIN REWARDS: Heavyrain's Token, Critical Response Team Office (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Records, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted
requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.
During the event rerun, the event button in [Side Story] will temporarily redirect you to the event rerun page.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Passenger, Heavyrain, and Toddifons will gain more trust during the event rerun.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – ERG PASSENGER
DURATION: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Erg Passenger", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Passenger
★★★★★: Toddifons / Sesa
03 VITAFIELD [FORUINER] SERIES CLASSICS NEW ARRIVAL AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store, including:
Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics – Tranquil Moss for Heavyrain
04 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Octopath Illusion for Hellagur
Bloodline of Combat Collection – Wind of Breaking Blade for Shirayuki
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – CRITICAL RESPONSE TEAM OFFICE
DURATION: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
A Walk in The Dust event rewards and redeem in event shop (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
06 OPERATOR RECORDS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Operator Records of the following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Exusiai
★★★★★: Waai Fu / Scene
07 PARADOX SIMULATIONS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: October 4, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Paradox Simulations for the following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★: Waai Fu / Scene
